written_by: Editor's list. Not taken from any source. To be corrected by trip reports.

items.reason: The coast takes the full monsoon
Salt air and sand wear a chain quickly

items.item: A wash for the bike after beach roads

items.reason: Village roads between towns have few shops
Ferries and small stalls often take only cash
A missed last ferry can add hours by road

items.item: Licence, registration, insurance and pollution certificate
Water, two litres on the bike

items.reason: Long days in open sun, with glare off the water
